messages.subject: dateInput Width
parts:
In my ui.R I have a wellPanel section that contains two dateInput fields side-by-side. I have noticed that when the app is run on smaller screens...the width of the dateInput field seems to stay the same size and looks distorted. How can I change the width of these fields so the scale with the size of the screen?

Thanks for any help.

Code Snippet:
wellPanel(
                  h5("Select Date Range:"),
                  div(class="row-fluid", 
                        div(style = widget_style, class="span6", 
                              dateInput("date_start", "From:", value = Sys.Date()-14)),
                        div(style = widget_style, class="span6", 
                              dateInput("date_end", "To:", value = Sys.Date()))),
                  tags$style(type="text/css", '#date_start {width: 100%}'),
                  tags$style(type="text/css", '#date_end {width: 100%}')
                  )
